title: Recycling round
summary: Sort the bottles at the recycling point, then swap a full bag.

steps.title: Sort the bottles
steps.instruction: Bottles with the deposit mark go to the return crate. Other plastic goes to the plastic bin.
steps.say: Bottles with the deposit mark go to the return crate, not the plastic bin.

criteria: No bottle with a deposit mark is in or above the plastic bin
Bottles with a deposit mark are in the return crate
check.warning: That's a deposit bottle. It goes to the return crate.

source.quote: Bottles with the deposit mark go to the return crate, not the plastic bin.

steps.title: Swap a full bag
steps.instruction: When the plastic bin is full, tie the bag and put a new one in.
steps.say: When the bin is full, tie the bag and put a new one in.

source.quote: When a bin is full, tie the bag and put a new one in.
